parameters.name: Inhibitory Ca2+ dissociation constant d2

parameters.name: Active subunits to open

parameters.source_note: Li & Rinzel 1994 (the cubic exponent); Shuai & Jung 2002 use the same 3-of-4 rule for single stochastic channels

parameters.name: ER/cytosol volume ratio c1

parameters.source_note: De Young & Keizer 1992, Table 1; the same values are used unchanged by Li & Rinzel 1994

parameters.name: Channels per cluster
parameters.description: Number of IP3Rs in the simulated cluster.
parameters.source_note: Order-of-magnitude choice: Smith & Parker 2009 resolve puffs made of a few to a few tens of channel openings; the cluster modelled here is a teaching default, not a measurement

parameters.name: Resting cytosolic Ca2+
parameters.description: Background Ca2+ each channel sees when no channel in the cluster is open.
parameters.source_note: The customary 100 nM resting level; the same value is the lower bound of the Li-Rinzel oscillation in its own figures

parameters.name: Cluster Ca2+ per open channel
parameters.description: Mean-field increment of the Ca2+ every channel in the cluster sees for each open channel — the coupling that turns a blip into a puff.
parameters.source_note: A mean-field simplification of Swillens et al. 1999, who show that puffs need inter-channel Ca2+ coupling; 1 uM per channel was chosen from a scan (0-2 uM at 0.05-0.2 uM IP3) as the value that most raises the Fano factor of simultaneous openings. The local nanodomain at an open pore is far higher and is not modelled

parameters.name: Puff simulation time step
parameters.description: Fixed step of the stochastic gate simulation.
parameters.source_note: Chosen so the fastest transition probability per step (a1 x IP3 or a5 x cluster Ca2+) stays below about 0.1 at the default parameters

parameters.name: ANM contact cutoff
parameters.description: C-alpha pairs closer than this are joined by a spring.
parameters.source_note: Atilgan et al. 2001 use 13-15 A; the upper end keeps a coarse-grained tetramer connected

parameters.name: ANM spring constant
parameters.description: Uniform stiffness scale; only eigenvalue ratios are reported.
parameters.source_note: Eigenvalues are arbitrary without a B-factor fit

parameters.name: ANM distance scale d0
parameters.description: Distance scale of the inverse-square spring weighting.
parameters.source_note: Yang et al. 2009 parameter-free ANM weighting

parameters.name: Modes computed
parameters.description: Non-trivial normal modes kept.
parameters.source_note: Enough to cover the collective motions; more only costs time

parameters.name: C-alpha stride
parameters.description: Keep every n-th C-alpha of each subunit.
parameters.source_note: A full tetramer is ~9,000 C-alphas; stride 2 solves in 1.2 s (stride 1: 7.8 s; 3: 0.4 s) and was chosen 2026-09-24 because it is the coarsest with no local modes on 8TKG. Not free: against stride 1 on 8TKG the RMSIP of 20 modes is 0.97 at stride 2, 0.89 at 3 and 0.77 at 4, because striding leaves a few pieces (8TKG residue 86, after unresolved 77-85) hanging on too few springs; their local modes take slots (network_checks)

parameters.name: C4 character tolerance
parameters.description: How close to an ideal character (+1, -1, 0) a mode must be to receive an irrep label.
parameters.source_note: Coarse-grained deposits are not perfectly symmetric; beyond this the mode is reported as mixed rather than forced into a label

parameters.name: Collective-mode threshold
parameters.description: Modes whose collectivity (Bruschweiler's kappa, the fraction of sites effectively moving) is below this are reported as local network artefacts, not collective motions.
parameters.source_note: The measure is Bruschweiler 1995; the threshold is ours. On the 8TKG network at strides 1-5 every mode is either <= 0.11 (weakly attached fragments, near-zero eigenvalues) or >= 0.27; 0.2 sits in that gap. At stride 4 the 'lowest A mode' was such a fragment (kappa 0.01, overlap 0.008) while the collective one below it had 0.49

parameters.name: Cutoff scan: lowest
parameters.description: Smallest cutoff of the sensitivity scan (network_checks.cutoff_scan).
parameters.source_note: Just below Atilgan et al. 2001's 13-15 A range; at stride 3 the network falls apart here (every mode local), which the scan should show rather than hide

parameters.name: Cutoff scan: highest
parameters.description: Largest cutoff of the sensitivity scan.
parameters.source_note: About the constant-coordination cutoff at stride 3: neighbours grow as rc^3/stride, so 15 A x 3^(1/3) = 21.6 A keeps stride 1's coordination

parameters.name: Cutoff scan: step
parameters.description: Spacing of the sensitivity scan's cutoffs.
parameters.source_note: Seven networks from 12 to 21 A; the lowest-A-mode overlap moves about 0.03 per step on 8TKG

parameters.name: Minimum common residues
parameters.description: Fewer residues common to both deposits than this and no transition is built.
parameters.source_note: A sanity floor, not a tuning knob: two deposits of one paralog share thousands (8TKG/8TKF: 2,198 per subunit); fewer than 50 means the wrong pair or the wrong numbering

parameters.name: Subunit correspondence tie
parameters.description: Cyclic subunit correspondences whose fit RMSD is within this of the best are treated as equally good; the tie goes to the deposited chain labels.
parameters.source_note: A C4-symmetric pair fits every cyclic relabelling to within ~0.01 A (8TKG->8TKF: 14.18 A for all four); 0.05 A is above that and far below any real mismatch

parameters.name: Morph frames
parameters.description: Solved frames between the two endpoints.
parameters.source_note: As the PIEZO1 simulator: smooth playback; more only costs time

parameters.name: Morph restraint iterations
parameters.description: SHAKE-style passes restoring peptide C-alpha-C-alpha distances per frame.
parameters.source_note: As the PIEZO1 simulator; the reported bond error shows whether it was enough

parameters.name: Peptide bond cut
parameters.description: Consecutive basis C-alphas farther apart than this in either endpoint are a chain break, not a bond, and are not restrained.
parameters.source_note: A trans peptide C-alpha-C-alpha distance is 3.8 A; 6 A admits coordinate error and excludes any gap of one missing residue or more

parameters.name: Displacement colour scale top
parameters.description: Per-residue displacement at which the fixed displacement ramp saturates.
parameters.source_note: Fixed, never auto-ranged, so two transitions painted with it can be compared; 8TKG->8TKF fitted on the pore domain has a 95th percentile of 24.1 A and a maximum of 30.6 A, so only the most mobile few per cent of the cytosolic assembly saturate

parameters.name: Pore profile step
parameters.description: Axial sampling interval of the pore profile.
parameters.source_note: The value ip3r_genes S0 used, so the two profiles share a grid

parameters.name: Pore profile half-slab
parameters.description: Half-thickness of the slab in which the minimum heavy-atom distance to the axis is taken.
parameters.source_note: The value ip3r_genes S0 used for structure_pore.tsv

parameters.name: Lining-residue half-slab
parameters.description: Half-thickness of the slab searched for the residues forming a constriction.
parameters.source_note: As ip3r_genes S0

parameters.name: Lining-residue radial tolerance
parameters.description: Atoms within this distance of the minimum radius count as lining the constriction.
parameters.source_note: As ip3r_genes S0

parameters.name: Ligand contact cutoff
parameters.description: Heavy-atom distance at which a residue counts as an IP3 contact.
parameters.source_note: The cutoff ip3r_genes S0 and S22 used for the ten measured contacts

parameters.name: Module coverage floor
parameters.description: Fraction of a module's reference columns an orthologue must resolve for its identity to enter the paired core-vs-pore test.
parameters.source_note: S22's MIN_MODULE_COVERAGE; a tip truncated at one end would otherwise enter as an extreme divergence in that module

parameters.name: Second-shell outer edge
parameters.description: All-atom distance to IP3 separating the second ligand shell from the third (the first shell is ligand.contact_cutoff).
parameters.source_note: S22's SHELL_EDGES: equal 3.5 A steps out from the 4.5 A contact cutoff

parameters.name: Third-shell outer edge
parameters.description: All-atom distance to IP3 separating the third ligand shell from the fourth.
parameters.source_note: S22's SHELL_EDGES

parameters.name: Ligand-shell search radius
parameters.description: Residues farther than this from IP3 belong to no shell (absent, not an open last bin).
parameters.source_note: S22's SEARCH_RADIUS_A: past 15 A no side chain of the binding core reaches the ligand

parameters.name: Gap-open cost
parameters.description: Cost of opening a gap in the pairwise alignment that carries residue numbers between paralogs.
parameters.source_note: EMBOSS needle's default with BLOSUM62 [henikoff1992]; the recursion is Gotoh's [gotoh1982]

parameters.name: Gap-extend cost
parameters.description: Cost of each further residue of a gap in the paralog-transfer alignment.
parameters.source_note: EMBOSS needle's default

parameters.name: Numbering-check identity
parameters.description: Fraction of residues a structure must share, by number, with a reference sequence to be declared in that reference's numbering.
parameters.source_note: The rule ip3r_genes S24 (D64) applied before painting variants on structures; strict, because an offset still aligns most residues with something

parameters.name: Minimum column occupancy
parameters.description: A conservation score is used only where at least this fraction of (weighted) sequences have a residue in the column.
parameters.source_note: S17's MIN_OCCUPANCY, so re-derived AUCs are computed on the positions S17 scored

parameters.name: Geometry agreement tolerance
parameters.description: Largest difference in a radius, residual or distance that still counts as reproducing the published value.
parameters.source_note: The published values are quoted to 0.01 A; 0.05 A allows for rounding and axis-fit differences and nothing else

parameters.name: Significance level
parameters.description: Level at which a check reads a published or re-derived p (or q) as significant when testing the pattern the prose states.
parameters.source_note: The level ip3r_genes' prose uses throughout

parameters.name: P-value agreement tolerance
parameters.description: Largest difference in log10 of a re-derived and a published p-value that still counts as agreement.
parameters.source_note: Published p-values carry six significant figures, and a normal approximation written independently of scipy's agrees with it to well under 0.01 decades; 0.02 leaves room for rounding only

parameters.name: Statistic agreement tolerance
parameters.description: Largest difference in a re-derived AUC, mean or fraction that still counts as agreement.
parameters.source_note: Published tables round to four decimals; 0.002 allows for rounding and tie-handling differences

parameters.name: SH-aLRT support bar
parameters.description: A tree node counts as supported only if its SH-like approximate likelihood-ratio support is at least this.
parameters.source_note: The IQ-TREE recommendation for SH-aLRT, and half of the joint bar ip3r_genes Paper 2 holds every claim to

parameters.name: UFBoot support bar
parameters.description: A tree node counts as supported only if its ultrafast bootstrap support is at least this.
parameters.source_note: Hoang et al.'s threshold for a clade to be considered real, and the other half of Paper 2's joint bar

parameters.name: Contiguity bar (contig N50)
parameters.description: An assembly counts as able to hold the gene when its contig N50 is at least this; the grid splits genomes above and below it.
parameters.source_note: ip3r_genes D4's bar, fixed before any error rate was known: the median measured genomic span of an ITPR gene (Paper 3, results/methods/contiguity_summary.json d4_bar)

parameters.name: Absence-clade proteome floor
parameters.description: A phylum or class is an absence target when at least this many of its reference proteomes were swept and none carries a call.
parameters.source_note: ip3r_genes S23 manifest rule G3 (results/s23_scope/report.md: 'one per clade S20 swept >= 10 proteomes of and found 0 ITPR in')

parameters.name: Substantial-match E-value
parameters.description: A relaxed-search hit is substantial only at or below this full-sequence E-value (with the coverage bar).
parameters.source_note: ip3r_genes S20's primary threshold, the strict side of its one-search-two-sensitivities design (results/s20_sweep/report.md)

parameters.name: Substantial-match model coverage
parameters.description: A relaxed-search hit is substantial only if it spans at least this fraction of the profile.
parameters.source_note: ip3r_genes S20: 'spanning at least half the model' (results/s20_sweep/report.md, negative-claims table)

parameters.name: Full-length family floor
parameters.description: A plant or fungal record shorter than this is a fragment of a gene, not a full-length receptor.
parameters.source_note: ip3r_genes S20 chase threshold min_length_aa (results/s20_sweep/verdict_summary.json)

parameters.name: Contaminant identity
parameters.description: A record this identical (or more) to one relative outside its kingdom, over the coverage bar, is an assembly-contamination suspect.
parameters.source_note: ip3r_genes S20 chase threshold contaminant_pident (results/s20_sweep/verdict_summary.json)

parameters.name: Contaminant coverage
parameters.description: Query coverage the contaminant identity must hold over.
parameters.source_note: ip3r_genes S20 chase threshold contaminant_qcov (results/s20_sweep/verdict_summary.json)

parameters.description: Rate of h42 while the channel is closed: the slow recovery from Ca2+ inhibition that Cao et al. 2013 found necessary for realistic inter-puff intervals.
parameters.source_note: Cao et al. 2014 Text S1 (6-state stochastic model code), the IP3R-1 fit of Siekmann et al. 2012 at 0.1 mM ATP as extended by Cao et al. 2013; read 2026-09-24. Cao 2013 treats it as a free parameter (a_h42, 1 s^-1 in its Fig. 2); 0.5 is the value in the 2014 code

parameters.name: Inhibition rate of h42 (channel open)
parameters.description: Rate of h42 while the channel is open: fast inhibition by the Ca2+ at its own mouth.
parameters.source_note: Cao et al. 2014 Text S1 (6-state stochastic model code), the IP3R-1 fit of Siekmann et al. 2012 at 0.1 mM ATP as extended by Cao et al. 2013; read 2026-09-24. Cao 2013 Eq. 10 writes it as a steep Ca2+ switch at 20 uM with V_h42 = 100 s^-1; the 2014 code switches on the open state with 20 s^-1, which is used here

parameters.name: Ca2+ at an open channel's mouth
parameters.description: Added to the cluster Ca2+ seen by an open receptor (its own nanodomain), after Rudiger's two-concentration puff model as used by Cao et al. 2013 (c_m = c + c_h).
parameters.source_note: Cao et al. 2014 Text S1 (6-state stochastic model code), the IP3R-1 fit of Siekmann et al. 2012 at 0.1 mM ATP as extended by Cao et al. 2013; read 2026-09-24: 120 uM x (store Ca2+ / 100 uM); the store is held full here, so 120 uM

parameters.name: Park/drive cluster time step
parameters.description: Step of the park/drive cluster simulation. The constant-rate transitions inside each mode are taken exactly over a step (matrix exponential); the Ca2+-dependent mode switches and the gating variables are updated once per step.
parameters.source_note: Cao et al. 2013: 'We choose a maximum time step size of 10^-4 s'

parameters.name: Cluster Ca2+ per open channel (park/drive)
parameters.description: Mean-field cluster Ca2+ increment per open channel for the park/drive cluster; the same coupling scheme as puff.ca_per_open.
parameters.source_note: Chosen by the rule used for puff.ca_per_open: the coupling (0-0.5 uM at 0.1-0.5 uM IP3) that most raises the Fano factor; it peaks at 0.1-0.2 (Fano 2.7-3.6). Cao et al. 2014's own microdomain gives about 0.11 uM per open channel (k_IPR x store Ca2+ / k_diff)

parameters.name: Observation bin
parameters.description: Both cluster simulators record, per bin, the number open at the bin's start (for the Fano factor) and the most open at once within it (for events).
parameters.source_note: Of the order of the frame time of fast puff imaging (Smith & Parker 2009 record at ~2 ms); it resolves the fast park-mode flickers (0.3 ms) as brief one-channel events rather than missing them

parameters.name: Large-event fraction of the cluster
parameters.description: An event whose peak reaches this fraction of the cluster counts as recruiting the cluster (a puff); the recruitment share is the fraction of multi-channel events that do.
parameters.source_note: Half the cluster: independent coincidences essentially never reach it (DYK uncoupled peaks at 6 of 20), while an all-or-none release should

parameters.name: Smallest non-zero coupling in the scan
parameters.description: The coupling scan runs 0 and then geometrically from this to puff.scan_max.
parameters.source_note: The step of the scan that chose puff.ca_per_open

parameters.name: Largest coupling in the scan
parameters.description: Top of the coupling scan.
parameters.source_note: The top of the scan that chose puff.ca_per_open

parameters.name: Non-zero couplings in the scan
parameters.description: Number of geometric steps from puff.scan_min to puff.scan_max.
parameters.source_note: About two points per factor of two over 0.05-2 uM

parameters.name: Temperature
parameters.description: Absolute temperature in the thermal voltage and the Nernst-Einstein conductivity.
parameters.source_note: Vais et al. 2010 (PMC2995152), Results: 'symmetric 140-mM KCl solutions ([K+]f = [Cl-]f ~ 104 mM) in the absence of Mg2+'; 'current traces were acquired at room temperature'; 23 C taken for room temperature

parameters.name: Bath KCl concentration
parameters.description: Symmetric bath salt. The nominal concentration, not the ~104 mM free (activity) value the paper also gives; the model has no activity coefficients.
parameters.source_note: Vais et al. 2010 (PMC2995152), Results: 'symmetric 140-mM KCl solutions ([K+]f = [Cl-]f ~ 104 mM) in the absence of Mg2+'; 'current traces were acquired at room temperature'

parameters.name: Test voltage
parameters.description: Voltage at which the chord conductance is evaluated.
parameters.source_note: Inside Vais 2010's -25 to +15 mV ramp, where their I-V is linear, so chord equals slope conductance

parameters.name: K+ bulk diffusivity
parameters.description: Bulk diffusion coefficient of K+.
parameters.source_note: K+ in water at 25 C; the standard tabulated value (as PIEZO1)

parameters.name: Cl- bulk diffusivity
parameters.description: Bulk diffusion coefficient of Cl-.
parameters.source_note: Cl- in water at 25 C; the standard tabulated value (as PIEZO1)

parameters.name: K+ crystal radius
parameters.description: Subtracted from the free radius to give the area a K+ centre can occupy.
parameters.source_note: Shannon radius. Crystal rather than hydrated, because an ion can shed water at a constriction - itself a modelling choice (as PIEZO1)

parameters.name: Cl- crystal radius
parameters.description: Subtracted from the free radius for Cl-.
parameters.source_note: Shannon radius

parameters.name: In-pore diffusivity fraction
parameters.description: In-pore diffusivity as a fraction of bulk, for both species.
parameters.source_note: Not measured for any IP3R. PIEZO1's value, kept so the two projects are comparable; with the ion radius it is what the answer is most sensitive to, so it is swept (permeation.sweep_*), never tuned

parameters.name: In-pore relative permittivity
parameters.description: Enters the reported Debye length and, in the radial closure only, the Poisson-Boltzmann screening across each slice.
parameters.source_note: Nanopore water is less polarisable than bulk (80); 40 is a common compromise (as PIEZO1)

parameters.name: Radial PB cells per slice
parameters.description: Finite-volume cells across each slice in the radial Poisson-Boltzmann closure.
parameters.source_note: Doubling it moves 8TKF's selectivity by less than the reported precision (tests/test_radial_pb.py pins the grid convergence)

parameters.name: Sweep: lowest diffusivity fraction
parameters.description: Low end of the in-pore diffusivity sweep.
parameters.source_note: PIEZO1's plausible range, 0.25-1.0 of bulk

parameters.name: Sweep: highest diffusivity fraction
parameters.description: High end of the in-pore diffusivity sweep (bulk water).
parameters.source_note: PIEZO1's plausible range

parameters.name: Sweep: smallest ion radius
parameters.description: Low end of the ion-radius sweep.
parameters.source_note: PIEZO1's plausible range, 1.0-2.0 A

parameters.name: Sweep: largest ion radius
parameters.description: High end of the ion-radius sweep.
parameters.source_note: PIEZO1's plausible range

parameters.name: ITPR3 conductance (DT40)
parameters.description: Rat InsP3R-3 in the outer nuclear membrane of DT40-KO cells, symmetric 140 mM KCl.

parameters.name: ITPR3 conductance (oocyte)
parameters.description: Rat InsP3R-3 in the Xenopus oocyte outer nuclear membrane, symmetric KCl, 0 Mg2+.
parameters.source_note: Mak 2000 (PMC2217211): 'the InsP3R-3 I-V relation became linear with a conductance of 358 +/- 8 pS'. Vais 2010 cites this paper as 370 +/- 8 pS; the primary text is used

parameters.name: Ca2+ bulk diffusivity
parameters.description: Bulk diffusion coefficient of Ca2+.
parameters.source_note: Ca2+ in water at 25 C; the standard tabulated value (limiting conductivity 59.5 S cm2/mol per charge)

parameters.name: Ca2+ crystal radius
parameters.description: Subtracted from the free radius for Ca2+.
parameters.source_note: Shannon radius, six-coordinate

parameters.name: P_K:P_Cl lumen KCl
parameters.description: Luminal KCl in the experiment that sets P_K:P_Cl (cytosol: the 140 mM bath).
parameters.source_note: Vais et al. 2010 (PMC2995152), read 2026-09-24. Methods/Results: '30 mM KCl, 110 mM NMDG chloride'

parameters.name: P_K:P_Cl lumen NMDG-Cl
parameters.description: Impermeant NMDG-Cl that keeps the luminal Cl- at 140 mM. NMDG+ is not a species in the pore; its Cl- is.
parameters.source_note: Vais et al. 2010 (PMC2995152), read 2026-09-24. Methods/Results: '30 mM KCl, 110 mM NMDG chloride'

parameters.name: NMDG+ mobility (bound)
parameters.description: In-pore diffusivity of NMDG+ relative to K+ for the bound in which it enters the pore but carries almost no current.
parameters.source_note: Only a bound: 1e-2 to 1e-4 move P_Cl:P_K of the neutral 8TKF pore by < 0.02 (0.75 to 0.73)

parameters.name: P_Ca:P_K lumen CaCl2
parameters.description: CaCl2 added to the luminal 140 mM KCl in the experiment that sets P_Ca:P_K.
parameters.source_note: Vais et al. 2010 (PMC2995152), read 2026-09-24. Methods/Results: '140 mM KCl, 10 mM HEPES ... and 10 mM XCl2'

parameters.name: i_Ca cytosolic Ca2+
parameters.description: Free Ca2+ on the cytosolic side in the i_Ca protocol.
parameters.source_note: Vais et al. 2010 (PMC2995152), read 2026-09-24. Methods/Results: '[Ca2+]i in the pipette solution was fixed at 3 uM'

parameters.name: i_Ca luminal Ca2+ (low)
parameters.description: Lowest luminal free Ca2+ of the i_Ca line.
parameters.source_note: Vais et al. 2010 (PMC2995152), read 2026-09-24. Methods/Results: '[Ca2+]f = 160 uM, 550 uM, and 1.1 mM'

parameters.name: i_Ca luminal Ca2+ (mid)
parameters.description: Middle luminal free Ca2+ of the i_Ca line.
parameters.source_note: Vais et al. 2010 (PMC2995152), read 2026-09-24. Methods/Results: '[Ca2+]f = 160 uM, 550 uM, and 1.1 mM'

parameters.name: i_Ca luminal Ca2+ (high)
parameters.description: Highest luminal free Ca2+ of the i_Ca line.
parameters.source_note: Vais et al. 2010 (PMC2995152), read 2026-09-24. Methods/Results: '[Ca2+]f = 160 uM, 550 uM, and 1.1 mM'

parameters.name: Measured P_Cl:P_K
parameters.description: InsP3R-3 chloride permeability relative to K+.
parameters.source_note: Vais et al. 2010 (PMC2995152), read 2026-09-24. Methods/Results: 'P Ca : P Sr : P Ba : P Mg : P Na : P K : P Cl = (15.2 +/- 0.6): ... :1:(0.27 +/- 0.01)'

parameters.name: Measured P_Ca:P_K
parameters.description: InsP3R-3 Ca2+ permeability relative to K+.
parameters.source_note: Vais et al. 2010 (PMC2995152), read 2026-09-24. Methods/Results: '(15.2 +/- 0.6)'

parameters.name: Measured i_Ca slope
parameters.description: Unitary Ca2+ current at 0 mV per mM luminal Ca2+ gradient, 140 mM KCl, no Mg2+.
parameters.source_note: Vais et al. 2010 (PMC2995152), read 2026-09-24. Methods/Results: Fig. 4: 'slope of 0.30 +/- 0.02 pA/mM'

parameters.name: P_Ca from the i_Ca slope
parameters.description: The Ca2+ permeability the i_Ca slope gives; GHK from 545 pS and the ratios gives ten times more (1.5e-17).
parameters.source_note: Vais et al. 2010 (PMC2995152), read 2026-09-24. Methods/Results: 'P Ca (1.5 x 10-18 m3 s-1) derived from the slope ... is an order of magnitude smaller than that (1.5 x 10-17 m3 s-1) estimated using g ch'

parameters.name: Charge lining margin
parameters.description: A charge centre lines the pore when it is at most this far outside the profile's atom-centre radius at its own height.
parameters.source_note: About one water diameter (2.8 A): a charge one hydration layer behind the lumen wall still acts on the ions in it. Swept in SESSION_LOG, not tuned

parameters.name: Stubbed side-chain reach
parameters.description: A stubbed ionisable residue is counted as unplaced when its C-alpha is within this plus the lining margin of the lumen.
parameters.source_note: C-alpha to guanidinium centre of an extended Arg, the longest ionisable side chain (PIEZO1's pore_charge.reach_arg)

parameters.name: Axial charge smoothing
parameters.description: Gaussian width each charge is spread over along the axis.
parameters.source_note: About a side chain's positional uncertainty at 3 A resolution; the total charge is conserved whatever it is (as PIEZO1)

parameters.name: Salt-bridge N-O distance
parameters.description: An acidic and a basic side chain are an ion pair (and cancel) when a charged oxygen and a charged nitrogen are at most this far apart.
parameters.source_note: Barlow & Thornton 1983, abstract: ion pairs 'less than or equal to 4 A between charged groups', from the like- vs opposite-charge distance distributions in 38 proteins. On 8TKF the answer depends on it: K2482-D2400 and D2518-R2524' sit at 4.2-4.4 A, so it is swept in SESSION_LOG, not tuned

parameters.name: Counterion packing ceiling
parameters.description: In-pore concentration above which a result is flagged; nothing is clipped to it.
parameters.source_note: Close-packed hydrated K+ is about 8 M, so 10 M is where a continuum of point ions has certainly stopped describing a solution (as PIEZO1)

parameters.name: Anchor window
parameters.description: Residues searched on each side of an unresolved stretch for anchors: resolved in the deposit, not a backbone+CB stub, and the same amino acid in the prediction.
parameters.source_note: Short enough that the fit is local to the seam (PIEZO1's blade fit went from 19 A globally to 2.4 A locally), long enough to hold two helical turns

parameters.name: Minimum anchors per side
parameters.description: An internal stretch is filled only with at least this many anchors on each side; a terminus, which has one side, needs twice as many there.
parameters.source_note: Three points fix a rigid-body placement; fewer on one side lets the fill pivot about the other

parameters.name: Seam join tolerance
parameters.description: A seam joins if the placed fill's end C-alpha lies within this distance of the deposit's flanking C-alpha; otherwise the seam is drawn and reported as broken.
parameters.source_note: A trans peptide spans 3.80 A. Hiding 31 stretches that 8TKG/8TKF resolve and filling them (structure/graft_calibration.py) gave seams up to 5.42 A (90th percentile 4.74) for fills of median 1.5 A RMSD; the first value, 4.5 A, failed 9 of those 62 true seams

parameters.name: Clash distance
parameters.description: A filled residue clashes if any of its heavy atoms is closer than this to a deposited heavy atom (the residues flanking its own seams excluded).
parameters.source_note: Well inside any non-bonded heavy-atom contact (>= ~3 A); only interpenetration counts

parameters.name: pLDDT confident
parameters.description: A predicted residue is 'confident' at or above this pLDDT; a fill's confident fraction is reported.
parameters.source_note: AlphaFold DB's four pLDDT bands (very low < 50 <= low < 70 <= confident < 90 <= very high), as defined in Jumper 2021 and used on every AlphaFold DB entry page

parameters.name: pLDDT low / very low edge
parameters.description: pLDDT below this is drawn in the very-low colour.
parameters.source_note: AlphaFold DB's four pLDDT bands (very low < 50 <= low < 70 <= confident < 90 <= very high), as defined in Jumper 2021 and used on every AlphaFold DB entry page

parameters.name: pLDDT very-high edge
parameters.description: pLDDT at or above this is drawn in the very-high colour.
parameters.source_note: AlphaFold DB's four pLDDT bands (very low < 50 <= low < 70 <= confident < 90 <= very high), as defined in Jumper 2021 and used on every AlphaFold DB entry page

parameters.name: RyR1 bath KCl concentration

parameters.name: RyR1 E4900N conductance
parameters.description: Recombinant rabbit RyR1-E4900N, a charge-neutralising pore mutant, symmetric 250 mM KCl.
parameters.source_note: Xu et al. 2006 (PMC1367051), Table 2, gamma K+ in symmetric 250 mM KCl: 505 +/- 3 pS (n = 3)

parameters.description: Recombinant rabbit RyR1-D4938N, a charge-neutralising pore mutant, symmetric 250 mM KCl.

parameters.description: Recombinant rabbit RyR1-D4945N, a charge-neutralising pore mutant, symmetric 250 mM KCl.

parameters.name: RyR1 activation off rate

parameters.source_note: Stern, Pizarro & Rios 1997 (PMC2229377), Table I: 'k o- Activating off rate 500 s-1'. With k_o this gives Ka = 7.1 uM; the text says 'the activating site ... was 10 uM'

parameters.name: RyR1 inactivation on rate
parameters.description: One-Ca2+ inactivation: rate k_i x c.
parameters.source_note: Stern, Pizarro & Rios 1997 (PMC2229377), Table I prints 'k i Inactivating on rate 2 x 10-6 M-1s-1', a sign typo: the text gives 'the K d for inactivation, also 10 uM', and 20 s-1 / 10 uM = 2 x 10^6 M-1 s-1 = 2 uM^-1 s^-1

parameters.name: RyR1 inactivation off rate
parameters.description: Recovery from inactivation.
parameters.source_note: Stern, Pizarro & Rios 1997 (PMC2229377), Table I: 'k i- Inactivating off rate 20 s-1'

parameters.name: RyR1 bell: Amax
parameters.description: Peak binding activity (B/Bmax) of the fitted bell.
parameters.source_note: Murayama et al. 2015 (PMC4482644), S1 Table, wild type at 25 C ([3H]ryanodine binding, 0.17 M NaCl, 1 mM AMP, no Mg2+): 'WT 25 ... 0.031 +/- 0.002'

parameters.name: RyR1 bell: KA
parameters.description: Half-activation of the fitted bell.

parameters.name: RyR1 bell: nA

parameters.name: RyR1 bell: KI

parameters.name: RyR1 bell: nI
parameters.description: Hill coefficient of inhibition, fixed in the fit.
parameters.source_note: Murayama 2015 Methods: 'fixed values for n A (1.2) and n I (1.5)'

parameters.name: RyR1 bell at 37 C: Amax
parameters.description: Peak binding activity of the wild-type bell at 37 C.
parameters.source_note: Murayama et al. 2015 (PMC4482644), S1 Table, wild type at 37 C ([3H]ryanodine binding, 0.17 M NaCl, 1 mM AMP, no Mg2+); read from the S1 Table .doc: 'WT 37 ... 0.107 +/- 0.006'

parameters.name: RyR1 bell at 37 C: KA
parameters.description: Half-activation of the wild-type bell at 37 C.
parameters.source_note: Murayama et al. 2015 (PMC4482644), S1 Table, wild type at 37 C ([3H]ryanodine binding, 0.17 M NaCl, 1 mM AMP, no Mg2+); read from the S1 Table .doc: KA 20.5 +/- 2.5 uM

parameters.name: RyR1 bell at 37 C: KI
parameters.description: Half-inhibition of the wild-type bell at 37 C.
parameters.source_note: Murayama et al. 2015 (PMC4482644), S1 Table, wild type at 37 C ([3H]ryanodine binding, 0.17 M NaCl, 1 mM AMP, no Mg2+); read from the S1 Table .doc: KI 0.41 +/- 0.04 mM

parameters.name: Spark cluster size
parameters.description: Ca2+-gated RyR1s in one cluster.
parameters.source_note: Stern 1997: 'the total number of channels, 2N, was 60', half V (voltage-coupled) and half C (Ca2+-gated) channels; the C channels are the ones a Ca2+-driven spark recruits

parameters.name: RyR1 unitary Ca2+ current
parameters.description: Current of one open channel, for the derived coupling.
parameters.source_note: Stern, Pizarro & Rios 1997 (PMC2229377), Table I: 'i C C channel unitary current 0.3 pA'

parameters.name: Ca2+ diffusion coefficient
parameters.description: Free Ca2+ diffusivity, for the derived coupling.
parameters.source_note: Stern, Pizarro & Rios 1997 (PMC2229377), Table I: 'D ca Ca2+ diffusion coefficient 5 x 10-6 cm2 s-1'

parameters.name: RyR1 channel spacing
parameters.description: Distance at which the derived coupling is evaluated.
parameters.source_note: Stern, Pizarro & Rios 1997 (PMC2229377), Table I: 'Channel spacing 30 nm'

parameters.name: Spark cluster Ca2+ update step
parameters.description: How often the cluster Ca2+ is updated; within a step the transition matrix is exact.
parameters.source_note: Measured here (8 seeds x 20 s): 1e-5 and 2.5e-5 s agree within noise (spark rate 1.56/1.48 s-1, median duration 125/116 ms), while 1e-4 s lengthens sparks by 15-20 %

parameters.name: Spark release duration (frog)
parameters.description: Measured open time of the release underlying a Ca2+ spark, compared with the model's spark duration.
parameters.source_note: Rios et al. 1999 (PMC2229636): 'a release current of 16.9 pA, coming from a source of 0.5 um, with an open time of 6.3 ms'. Frog skeletal muscle, not mammalian RyR1: a scale, not a target

parameters.name: Spark scan: lowest coupling factor
parameters.description: Low end of the spark coupling scan, as a multiple of the derived coupling.
parameters.source_note: Buffers reduce the free-diffusion estimate; a 30-fold band below it covers strong buffering

parameters.name: Spark scan: highest coupling factor
parameters.description: High end of the spark coupling scan, as a multiple of the derived coupling.
parameters.source_note: The derived value is an unbuffered upper estimate, so the scan stops at it

parameters.name: Couplon width
parameters.description: Width of the junctional cleft: two rows of channels, one channel spacing apart.
parameters.source_note: Stern, Pizarro & Rios 1997 (PMC2229377), Table I and Fig. 7 B (double row, V and C channels alternating): 'Couplon width 60 nm'

parameters.name: Junctional gap thickness
parameters.description: Height of the cleft; diffusion is two-dimensional across it.
parameters.source_note: Stern, Pizarro & Rios 1997 (PMC2229377), Table I and Fig. 7 B (double row, V and C channels alternating): 'Junctional gap thickness 15 nm'

parameters.name: Release source diameter
parameters.description: Each open channel releases uniformly over a disc of this diameter (the foot).
parameters.source_note: Stern 1997 Appendix: 'we treated Ca2+ release as a diffuse source spread over a 30-nm-diameter disk representing the foot process'

parameters.name: Edge boundary: background distance
parameters.description: Distance at which Ca2+ escaping the cleft edge reaches background; sets the edge transfer coefficient D_inf = 2 pi D / (h ln(R_max / h)).
parameters.source_note: Stern 1997 Appendix, Eq. 13: 'R max, which was taken as the length scale of the junctional strip (1 um)'

parameters.name: Cleft finite-volume grid spacing
parameters.description: Cell size of the steady-state diffusion solve that gives the coupling coefficients.
parameters.source_note: Measured here: the coupling coefficients at 1 nm and 0.5 nm agree to < 1 %

parameters.name: Termination scan: lowest Ki
parameters.description: Low end of the inactivation constant scan (on-rate held at Stern's k_i, off-rate moved).
parameters.source_note: Below Stern's 10 uM, to see whether a still more sensitive inactivation shortens sparks

parameters.name: Termination scan: highest Ki
parameters.description: High end of the inactivation constant scan.
parameters.source_note: Covers Murayama's measured KI at 25 C (270 uM) and 37 C (410 uM)

parameters.name: Termination scan: Ki points
parameters.description: Geometric steps of the Ki scan.
parameters.source_note: Two to three per decade

parameters.name: Termination scan: fastest inactivation
parameters.description: Largest multiple of Stern's inactivation rates (on and off together, Ki fixed) in the rate scan; the scan runs from its inverse to it.
parameters.source_note: Steady state fixes only the ratio k_i-/k_i, so the rate is scanned over 3 decades

parameters.name: Termination scan: rate points
parameters.description: Geometric steps of the rate scan.
parameters.source_note: Two to three per decade

parameters.name: Cytosolic free Mg2+ (muscle)
parameters.description: Free Mg2+ in the resting fibre cytosol; the spark Mg2+ scan ends here.
parameters.source_note: Laver 2018 review: 'physiological concentrations of Mg2+ (1 mM (Godt and Maughan 1988))'

parameters.name: RyR1 activation site: Mg2+ affinity
parameters.description: Dissociation constant of Mg2+ at the Ca2+ activation (A-) site, competitive with Ca2+.
parameters.source_note: Laver, O'Neill & Lamb 2004 (PMC2234024), Table I: RyR1 (rabbit) in bilayers, 2 mM ATP, luminal Ca2+ 1 mM, cytoplasmic Cs+ 250 mM: Kapp(Mg2+) 54 +/- 4 uM (DIDS-modified: 120 +/- 17 uM). Measured with ATP present, which Murayama's bell lacks; the Laver 2018 review gives '~50 uM' for the A-site

parameters.name: RyR1 inactivation site: Mg2+/Ca2+ affinity
parameters.description: Mg2+ affinity of the low-affinity inactivation (I1-) site relative to Ca2+'s: the inactivation gate's ligand is c + ratio x Mg2+.
parameters.source_note: Laver et al. 1997 abstract: 'the inhibitory effects of Ca2+ and Mg2+ were virtually identical for the same conditions in any given channel'; Hill coefficient ~2 there, 1 in this gate

parameters.name: RyR1 activation site: Ca2+ affinity (Laver)
parameters.description: The A-site Ca2+ affinity measured beside ryr.k_mg_a in the same condition; their ratio is the Mg2+/Ca2+ selectivity of the site.
parameters.source_note: Laver, O'Neill & Lamb 2004 (PMC2234024), Table I: RyR1 (rabbit) in bilayers, 2 mM ATP, luminal Ca2+ 1 mM, cytoplasmic Cs+ 250 mM: Kapp(Ca2+)c 0.51 +/- 0.07 uM (ratio to Kapp(Mg2+) 106; DIDS 133)

parameters.name: Mg2+ inhibition constant (Meissner)
parameters.description: Competitive Mg2+ constant at the Ca2+ activation site, in the assay Murayama used.
parameters.source_note: Meissner, Rios, Tripathy & Pasek 1997 (JBC 272:1628), Table IV: [3H]ryanodine binding, 0.5 M choline-Cl, fitted with their Eqs. 3-4 (K_eff^na = Ka^na (1 + ([I]/Ki)^ni)), mean +/- S.D.: Ca2+/Mg2+ with 5 mM AMP, Ki 0.018 +/- 0.009 mM (n = 4); without AMP 0.013 +/- 0.004 mM. The +AMP row because Murayama's bell had 1 mM AMP

parameters.name: Mg2+ Hill coefficient (Meissner)
parameters.description: Hill coefficient of the Mg2+ term in Eq. 4.
parameters.source_note: Meissner, Rios, Tripathy & Pasek 1997 (JBC 272:1628), Table IV: [3H]ryanodine binding, 0.5 M choline-Cl, fitted with their Eqs. 3-4 (K_eff^na = Ka^na (1 + ([I]/Ki)^ni)), mean +/- S.D.: +AMP 1.2 +/- 0.3; -AMP 1.1 +/- 0.1

parameters.name: Ca2+ activation Hill coefficient (Meissner)
parameters.description: The Ca2+ Hill coefficient na of the same fit; the shift of half-activation is the na-th root of Eq. 4's factor.
parameters.source_note: Meissner, Rios, Tripathy & Pasek 1997 (JBC 272:1628), Table IV: [3H]ryanodine binding, 0.5 M choline-Cl, fitted with their Eqs. 3-4 (K_eff^na = Ka^na (1 + ([I]/Ki)^ni)), mean +/- S.D.: Ca2+/Mg2+ +AMP na 2.0 +/- 0.2 (Ka 0.18 uM); -AMP 1.9 +/- 0.4 (Ka 0.39 uM)

parameters.name: Na+ inhibition constant (Meissner)
parameters.description: Competitive Na+ constant at the same site: Murayama's NaCl occupies it too.
parameters.source_note: Meissner, Rios, Tripathy & Pasek 1997 (JBC 272:1628), Table IV: [3H]ryanodine binding, 0.5 M choline-Cl, fitted with their Eqs. 3-4 (K_eff^na = Ka^na (1 + ([I]/Ki)^ni)), mean +/- S.D.: Ca2+/Na+ +AMP Ki 24 +/- 6 mM (n = 3); -AMP 27 +/- 7 mM

parameters.name: Na+ Hill coefficient (Meissner)
parameters.description: Hill coefficient of the Na+ term.
parameters.source_note: Meissner, Rios, Tripathy & Pasek 1997 (JBC 272:1628), Table IV: [3H]ryanodine binding, 0.5 M choline-Cl, fitted with their Eqs. 3-4 (K_eff^na = Ka^na (1 + ([I]/Ki)^ni)), mean +/- S.D.: +AMP 1.7 +/- 0.2; -AMP 1.8 +/- 0.2

parameters.name: Na+ in Murayama's assay
parameters.description: The Na+ competing at the activation site in the condition the fitted bell was measured in.
parameters.source_note: Murayama et al. 2015 (PMC4482644), S1 Table, wild type at 25 C ([3H]ryanodine binding, 0.17 M NaCl, 1 mM AMP, no Mg2+)

parameters.name: Mg2+ scan: lowest non-zero Mg2+
parameters.description: Low end of the free Mg2+ scan of cleft sparks (0 is always included).
parameters.source_note: A fifth of the A-site affinity: where Mg2+ begins to matter

parameters.name: Mg2+ scan: non-zero points
parameters.description: Geometric steps from spark.mg_scan_min to ryr.mg_free.
parameters.source_note: Two to three per decade

parameters.name: Triggered spark: trials
parameters.description: Seeds per triggered-spark measurement (every available channel opened at t = 0).
parameters.source_note: Enough for a median; each trial is one spark

parameters.name: Triggered spark: window
parameters.description: How long a triggered array is followed; a spark still running then is counted as not ended.
parameters.source_note: 300x the 6.3 ms measured release, 10x the longest ended spark seen

parameters.name: RyR1 use-dependent inactivation rate at 0 mV
parameters.description: Rate at which a conducting RyR1 enters use-dependent inactivation, at the SR's resting potential (taken as 0 mV). Entered only from the open state, so it is Ca2+-independent. Only ryr.use_recovery_ratio decides the steady state, the fitted Ca2+ gate and spark termination; this rate sets how fast the gate relaxes, far slower than a spark.
parameters.source_note: Laver & Lamb 1998, full text (rabbit skeletal and sheep cardiac RyRs in bilayers, 250 mM Cs+), Fig. 4: log10 of the macroscopic inactivation rate against bilayer potential, cardiac RyRs at Po > 0.8, the fit at positive potentials having 'slope and intercept at V = 0' of 20 V^-1 and 0.056 s^-1. The intercept is an extrapolation: the data start near +20 mV. The abstract's 'tau approximately 1-3 s' is at +40 mV (the same line gives 0.35 s^-1 there, tau 2.8 s), which Round 6.9 took for this rate. Skeletal RyRs were not measured against voltage

parameters.name: Use-gate rate: voltage slope
parameters.description: log10 of the inactivation rate per volt of bilayer potential (cytosol relative to lumen), positive limb. Used only to check the reading of Fig. 4 against the paper's own abstract and charge estimate.
parameters.source_note: Laver & Lamb 1998, full text (rabbit skeletal and sheep cardiac RyRs in bilayers, 250 mM Cs+), Fig. 4 legend; 20 V^-1 in log10 is z delta 1.18, as the text's 1.14 +- 0.25

parameters.name: RyR1 use-gate recovery / inactivation
parameters.description: k_use-/k_use: the use gate's recovery rate relative to its rate from the open state. The one number Round 6.9's result rests on: with both rates far slower than a spark, the steady state, the refitted Ca2+ gate and spark termination depend on this ratio and not on either rate.
parameters.source_note: Laver & Lamb 1998, full text (rabbit skeletal and sheep cardiac RyRs in bilayers, 250 mM Cs+) report no recovery rate at a fixed potential: inactivated channels recovered only when the voltage was reversed ('reactivated in milliseconds'), and at +40 mV 'remained closed until ... reactivated by a brief voltage pulse to -40 mV'. Their Fig. 8 bounds the ratio at +40 mV only (ryr.use_residual_40mv_*: at most 0.03-0.52). 0.2 lies inside that span; at 0 mV nothing is measured, so the value is unverified and the ratio is scanned

parameters.name: Use gate: least residual at +40 mV
parameters.description: Ensemble activity 5 s after a step from -40 to +40 mV, relative to its peak: the most inactivated skeletal RyR. A residual R bounds the recovery ratio by R/(1-R) (Po <= 1, and 5 s is not quite steady state).
parameters.source_note: Laver & Lamb 1998, full text (rabbit skeletal and sheep cardiac RyRs in bilayers, 250 mM Cs+), Fig. 8 (skeletal, open circles, y axis), read from the figure to about +-0.02; three of the six skeletal channels did not inactivate (residual 1) and are the heterogeneity, not this bound

parameters.name: Use gate: largest residual at +40 mV
parameters.description: As ryr.use_residual_40mv_min, for the least inactivated skeletal RyR that inactivated at all.
parameters.source_note: Laver & Lamb 1998, full text (rabbit skeletal and sheep cardiac RyRs in bilayers, 250 mM Cs+), Fig. 8, read to about +-0.02

parameters.name: RyR1 share carrying the use gate
parameters.description: Share of a cluster's RyR1 channels that have use-dependent inactivation at all; the rest never enter it. A stable property of the channel: 'only those that showed inactivation after voltage steps inactivated after [Ca2+] steps, and vice versa'. Read by ryr_mixed.
parameters.source_note: Laver & Lamb 1998, full text (rabbit skeletal and sheep cardiac RyRs in bilayers, 250 mM Cs+), Results: of channels with Po above 0.2, '80% of skeletal RyRs (12 of 15)' inactivated within 30 s of voltage steps (cardiac 56 %, 33 of 59); the abstract's 'one-half to two-thirds' pools both. Laver & Curtis 1996 (Biophys J 71:732): 70 % of 25 cardiac and skeletal channels declined after Ca2+ steps; Ma 1995: 50-70 % of skeletal; Sitsapesan et al. 1995 (cardiac, +40 mV): 17 % (4 of 24) with Ca2+ alone, 56 % (5 of 9) with ATP or EMD 41000, the Po dependence Laver & Lamb's Po > 0.2 selection removes. The skeletal count is used; the fraction is scanned from 0 to 1

parameters.name: RyR2 Po early at -40 mV
parameters.description: Open probability just after a rapid step to activating ligands, at -40 mV: the start of a 5-s record in which no inactivation was seen. Checks the use-gate rate read from Laver & Lamb's Fig. 4.
parameters.source_note: Sitsapesan et al. 1995, Results and Fig. 2: sheep cardiac RyRs activated by 100 uM Ca2+ plus 1 mM ATP, held at -40 mV cis (cytosol) relative to trans; ensemble Po in the first and last part of a 5-s exposure, mean +- SEM, n = 5: Po early 0.841 +- 0.087

parameters.name: RyR2 Po late at -40 mV
parameters.description: As ryr.sitsapesan_po_early_m40, at the end of the 5-s exposure.
parameters.source_note: Sitsapesan et al. 1995, Results and Fig. 2: sheep cardiac RyRs activated by 100 uM Ca2+ plus 1 mM ATP, held at -40 mV cis (cytosol) relative to trans; ensemble Po in the first and last part of a 5-s exposure, mean +- SEM, n = 5: Po late 0.874 +- 0.072

parameters.name: RyR2 Po at -40 mV: larger SEM
parameters.description: The larger of the two SEMs, used for both when the late/early ratio's uncertainty is formed (as if independent: conservative, the pairs are one channel each).
parameters.source_note: Sitsapesan et al. 1995, Results and Fig. 2: sheep cardiac RyRs activated by 100 uM Ca2+ plus 1 mM ATP, held at -40 mV cis (cytosol) relative to trans; ensemble Po in the first and last part of a 5-s exposure, mean +- SEM, n = 5: SEM 0.087 (early), 0.072 (late)

parameters.name: RyR2 record at -40 mV: duration
parameters.description: How long the channels were held open at -40 mV without a decline in Po.
parameters.source_note: Sitsapesan et al. 1995, Fig. 2: 'over several seconds', 5-s exposures to the activating solution

parameters.name: RyR1 low-activity share
parameters.description: Share of skeletal RyRs in the low-activity gating mode: Po below ~0.1 at every Ca2+, activated and inhibited only at 0.1-0.3 mM. They sit inside any population bell; ryr_mixed.low_activity puts them there.
parameters.source_note: Copello et al. 1997, Results ('LA skeletal RyRs'): rabbit skeletal RyRs, Ca2+ as charge carrier, 0 mV: '~35% of the single-channel experiments (7 of 20 ..., and 4 of 14 in the presence of Mg2+ and ATP)'

parameters.name: RyR1 low-activity peak Po
parameters.description: Peak open probability of a low-activity channel. The paper's ceiling, so the bound is a best case.
parameters.source_note: Copello et al. 1997, Results ('LA skeletal RyRs'): rabbit skeletal RyRs, Ca2+ as charge carrier, 0 mV: 'PO reached maximum values of ~0.1' at 100-200 uM; abstract 'PO < 0.1 at all [Ca2+]'

parameters.name: RyR1 low-activity EC50: low end
parameters.description: Half-activation of low-activity channels, low end of the range.
parameters.source_note: Copello et al. 1997, Results ('LA skeletal RyRs'): rabbit skeletal RyRs, Ca2+ as charge carrier, 0 mV: EC50 '~70 to 150 uM' (six experiments)

parameters.name: RyR1 low-activity EC50: high end
parameters.description: As ryr.la_ec50_min, high end.
parameters.source_note: Copello et al. 1997, Results ('LA skeletal RyRs'): rabbit skeletal RyRs, Ca2+ as charge carrier, 0 mV: EC50 '~70 to 150 uM'

parameters.name: RyR1 low-activity IC50: low end
parameters.description: Half-inhibition of low-activity channels, low end of the range.
parameters.source_note: Copello et al. 1997, Results ('LA skeletal RyRs'): rabbit skeletal RyRs, Ca2+ as charge carrier, 0 mV: IC50 'in the range of 100-300 uM (n = 5)'

parameters.name: RyR1 low-activity IC50: high end
parameters.description: As ryr.la_ic50_min, high end.
parameters.source_note: Copello et al. 1997, Results ('LA skeletal RyRs'): rabbit skeletal RyRs, Ca2+ as charge carrier, 0 mV: IC50 '100-300 uM'

parameters.name: RyR1 low-activity activation Hill slope
parameters.description: Hill coefficient of the low-activity channels' activation, taken from the high-activity channels.
parameters.source_note: Copello 1997 could not fit the LA channels ('the low PO precludes the use of fitting algorithms'); 2.6 is the HA skeletal mean (range 0.8-5.0)

parameters.name: RyR1 low-activity inhibition Hill slope
parameters.description: Hill coefficient of the low-activity channels' inhibition, taken from the high-activity channels.
parameters.source_note: Not fitted for LA channels; 3.7 is the HA single-channel mean (range 2-5.1)

parameters.name: Inactivating-fraction scan: points
parameters.description: Evenly spaced inactivating fractions from 0 to 1 in the mixed-cluster scan.
parameters.source_note: Steps of 0.2: the measured 0.5-0.8 falls on two of them

parameters.name: Use-gate scan: fastest time constant
parameters.description: Low end of the scan of the use gate's time constant from the open state; also the fastest use gate the couplon is run with.
parameters.source_note: 1 ms: below the 6.3 ms measured release, so a gate this fast could end a spark on its own

parameters.name: Use-gate scan: slowest time constant
parameters.description: High end of the scan.
parameters.source_note: Beyond Laver & Lamb's measured 1-3 s, so the measured range lies inside the scan

parameters.name: Use-gate scan: points
parameters.description: Geometric steps of the use-gate scan.
parameters.source_note: Two per decade over the four decades from 1 ms to 10 s

parameters.name: Use-gate ratio scan: widest factor
parameters.description: Largest multiple of ryr.use_recovery_ratio in the ratio scan; the scan runs from its inverse to it. The ratio is load-bearing and unmeasured at 0 mV, so its effect is measured rather than assumed.
parameters.source_note: Two decades around the unverified value: brackets a cluster that never fires and one that never stops

parameters.name: Use-gate ratio scan: points
parameters.description: Geometric steps of the ratio scan.
parameters.source_note: Four per decade: the working band is under a decade wide

parameters.name: Rios 2026 inactivation half time
parameters.description: Half time of entry into inactivation from the open state (O -> I1, entered from no other state) in Rios & Pizarro's couplon, the use gate's entry at millisecond speed: k_use = ln2 / this (Round 6.13).
parameters.source_note: Rios & Pizarro 2026 (PMC13387315), full text, Table 1 'I1_ht 3.5' (its dimension column reads 'time^-1, ms^-1', but the Methods define I1_ht = log2/k_I1, a half time in ms). Discussion: 'the first inactivation rate must be near 3 ms to match the fast decay from peak flux'. Fitted to cell-level flux of mammalian fibres, not a single-channel measurement

parameters.name: Rios 2026 recovery half time
parameters.description: Half time of recovery from the first inactivated state (I1 -> C): k_use- = ln2 / this. Its ratio to ryr.rios_i1_half_time's rate is 0.175.
parameters.source_note: Rios & Pizarro 2026 (PMC13387315), full text, Table 1 'R1_ht 20'. The scheme's deep state I2 (I2_ht 50, R2_ht 50 ms) is not carried: it slows recovery between pulses and cannot shorten a spark. Recovery is anchored to tau 110 ms at the resting potential (Sarkozi et al. 2000)

parameters.name: Voltage-sensor steepness K
parameters.description: Boltzmann steepness of one sensor, written 4K: Pa/Pr = exp((V - V_bar)/4K).
parameters.source_note: Rios et al. 1993 (supplied PDF), Table I, fiber 827 (reference): K 4.5 mV

parameters.name: Voltage-sensor midpoint V_bar
parameters.description: Voltage at which a sensor on a closed channel is equally resting and activating.
parameters.source_note: Rios et al. 1993 (supplied PDF), Table I, fiber 827 (reference): V_bar -20 mV

parameters.name: V-channel opening rate k_L
parameters.description: Opening rate with no sensor activated; each activated sensor divides it by f.
parameters.source_note: Rios et al. 1993 (supplied PDF), Table I, fiber 827 (reference): k_L 0.002 /ms

parameters.name: V-channel closing rate k_-L
parameters.description: Closing rate with no sensor activated; each activated sensor multiplies it by f.
parameters.source_note: Rios et al. 1993 (supplied PDF), Table I, fiber 827 (reference): k_-L 900 /ms

parameters.name: Allosteric factor f
parameters.description: Per activated sensor, the opening rate x 1/f and the closing rate x f (closing equilibrium x f^2).
parameters.source_note: Rios et al. 1993 (supplied PDF), Table I, fiber 827 (reference): f 0.175

parameters.name: Sensor rate alpha
parameters.description: Inverse time constant of one sensor at V_bar: k_c = alpha/2 exp((V - V_bar)/8K), k_-c = alpha/2 exp(-(V - V_bar)/8K) (Eqs. 2-3).
parameters.source_note: Rios 1993 Table I legend: 'the kinetic constant of charge movement ... was always 0.2 ms-1'

parameters.name: Stern's V-channel rate factor
parameters.description: Every time-dimensioned rate of the Rios model (alpha, k_L, k_-L) is multiplied by this; equilibria are unchanged.
parameters.source_note: Stern, Pizarro & Rios 1997 (PMC2229377): 'with time-dimensioned rate constants increased by a factor of 2'. Their couplon runs (Fig. 12, V at 0 mV: 0.43 at 10 ms) follow x2; their stand-alone V check (Fig. 11) follows the printed rates (x1), so it was made before the factor (tests/test_allosteric_v.py holds both)

parameters.name: V-channel unitary Ca2+ current
parameters.description: Current of one open V channel, for its Ca2+ at the C channels.
parameters.source_note: Stern, Pizarro & Rios 1997 (PMC2229377), Table I: 'i V V channel unitary current 0.1 pA'

parameters.name: Holding potential
parameters.description: Membrane potential before and after the pulse; the array starts from its stationary state here.
parameters.source_note: Stern, Pizarro & Rios 1997 (PMC2229377): release 'during 100-ms depolarizations from a holding potential of -90 mV'

parameters.name: Pulse duration
parameters.description: Length of the depolarising step.
parameters.source_note: Stern, Pizarro & Rios 1997 (PMC2229377): 100-ms step depolarizations (Figs. 1, 11, 12)

parameters.name: Record after the pulse
parameters.description: How long the array is followed after repolarisation.
parameters.source_note: As Stern's Figs. 11-12 (200 ms traces)

parameters.name: Plateau window
parameters.description: The plateau is the mean over this last part of the pulse.
parameters.source_note: Stern's Fig. 12 plateaus are flat over the last ~60 ms of the 100-ms pulse; 40 ms keeps clear of the peak's tail at -50 mV

parameters.name: Couplons per ensemble
parameters.description: Independent couplons averaged for an open probability or flux (Stern averaged 1,000-10,000).
parameters.source_note: Enough for a peak to ~5 %; the CLI can raise it

parameters.name: Voltage for single events
parameters.description: Where V openings are sparse and C events stand apart, so their durations can be read.
parameters.source_note: Stern, Pizarro & Rios 1997 (PMC2229377), Fig. 14: the couplon at -50 mV, one V-triggered wave at a time

parameters.name: Voltage scan: lowest
parameters.description: First step potential of the voltage scan.
parameters.source_note: Stern's Fig. 1 B runs from -60 mV

parameters.name: Voltage scan: highest
parameters.description: Last step potential of the voltage scan.
parameters.source_note: Stern's Figs. 11-12 top at 0 mV

parameters.name: Voltage scan: step
parameters.description: Spacing of the voltage scan.
parameters.source_note: Stern's Fig. 1 B steps by 10 mV

parameters.name: SR Ca2+ content at rest
parameters.description: Releasable SR Ca2+ as a concentration in accessible myoplasmic water; the unitary currents scale with the fraction left.
parameters.source_note: Stern, Pizarro & Rios 1997 (PMC2229377), Fig. 20: 'starting from an intra-SR calcium content equivalent to 2 mM in accessible myoplasmic water'. Rios 1993 (Fig. 2) measured 1.5 and 1.2 mM in fiber 827

parameters.name: Couplon density
parameters.description: Couplons per unit fibre volume: turns one couplon's release current into a rate of SR emptying.
parameters.source_note: Stern, Pizarro & Rios 1997 (PMC2229377): 'The density of couplons was 4.8 um-3' (junctional t-tubule area per Z disk from Peachey & Eisenberg 1978, times Z disks per length)

parameters.name: SR refilling time constant
parameters.description: Uptake returns the content to rest exponentially with this time constant (first order in the deficit).
parameters.source_note: Stern, Pizarro & Rios 1997 (PMC2229377), Fig. 20 C, digitised: after the pulse the content goes 0.655 -> 0.929 mM (0 mV) and 1.34 -> 1.467 mM (-30 mV) in 96 ms, tau 421 and 450 ms. Their uptake is the Brum 1988 pump driven by global Ca2+, which runs faster during the pulse, so first order under-refills there

parameters.name: Fig. 20 couplon: C channels
parameters.description: C channels in the couplon of the depletion calibration (as many V channels again).
parameters.source_note: Stern, Pizarro & Rios 1997 (PMC2229377), Fig. 20: 'The dynamics of the model (28 channels/couplon)'

parameters.name: SR path: most iterations
parameters.description: The content path and the ensemble's release are made consistent by fixed-point iteration, at most this often.
parameters.source_note: Converged in 4-7 on Stern's constants and up to 10 on the fitted scheme (Round 6.7)

parameters.name: SR path: tolerance
parameters.description: Iteration stops when no point of the content fraction moves by more than this.
parameters.source_note: 1 % of the content: below the ensemble's sampling noise at 200 couplons

parameters.name: SR path: damping
parameters.description: Each iteration moves the path this fraction of the way to the new one (1 = plain substitution).
parameters.source_note: Plain substitution oscillates when the store empties within the pulse

parameters.name: Released by a conditioning pulse: low
parameters.description: Fraction of SR content lost in a 100-ms pulse to +20 mV (fiber 827, 10 C).
parameters.source_note: Rios 1993 Fig. 2 text: 'This depletion is ~60% for the pulse shown early in the experiment and ~50% in the late record'

parameters.name: Released by a conditioning pulse: high
parameters.description: As the low value, early in the experiment.
parameters.source_note: Rios 1993 Fig. 2 text (see the low value)

parameters.name: Conditioning pulse voltage
parameters.description: Step of Rios's conditioning pulse (100 ms from -80 mV).
parameters.source_note: Rios 1993 Figs. 1-2: conditioning pulse to +20 mV, 100 ms

parameters.name: Local depletion in a spark: most
parameters.description: Largest fall of free SR Ca2+ measured during a skeletal spark (frog, SEER).
parameters.source_note: Launikonis et al. 2006 PNAS (PMC1413852): 'implying a reduction of [Ca2+]SR by at most 7.4%' (sulfate, sparks above the median)

parameters.name: Cytosol : microdomain volume ratio
parameters.description: Fluxes into and out of the microdomain are multiplied by this, so the microdomain relaxes 100x faster than the cytosol.
parameters.source_note: Cao et al. 2014 Text S1 (6-state stochastic model code), read 2026-09-25

parameters.name: Cytosol : ER volume ratio
parameters.description: Store Ca2+ is cs = gamma2 (ct - cb/gamma1 - c).
parameters.source_note: Cao et al. 2014 Text S1 (6-state stochastic model code), read 2026-09-25

parameters.name: Release rate constant per open receptor
parameters.description: Flux through one open receptor, k_ipr (cs - cb), in cytosolic units.
parameters.source_note: Cao et al. 2014 Text S1 (6-state stochastic model code), read 2026-09-25: kipr = 0.05/Num_IPR with Num_IPR = 20. Registered per receptor, the constant single-channel flux Cao 2013 assumes, so a larger cluster releases more

parameters.name: Microdomain -> cytosol exchange
parameters.description: Jdiff = k_diff (cb - c); with gamma1 the microdomain's own relaxation is gamma1 x k_diff = 1000/s.
parameters.source_note: Cao et al. 2014 Text S1 (6-state stochastic model code), read 2026-09-25

parameters.name: ER leak
parameters.description: Jleak = k_leak (cs - c).
parameters.source_note: Cao et al. 2014 Text S1 (6-state stochastic model code), read 2026-09-25

parameters.name: SERCA maximum
parameters.description: Jserca = V c^n / (c^n + K^n).
parameters.source_note: Cao et al. 2014 Text S1 (6-state stochastic model code), read 2026-09-25

parameters.name: SERCA half-activation
parameters.description: SERCA K.
parameters.source_note: Cao et al. 2014 Text S1 (6-state stochastic model code), read 2026-09-25

parameters.name: SERCA Hill coefficient
parameters.description: SERCA n.
parameters.source_note: Cao et al. 2014 Text S1 (6-state stochastic model code), read 2026-09-25

parameters.name: Plasma-membrane pump maximum
parameters.source_note: Cao et al. 2014 Text S1 (6-state stochastic model code), read 2026-09-25

parameters.name: Plasma-membrane pump half-activation
parameters.description: PMCA K.
parameters.source_note: Cao et al. 2014 Text S1 (6-state stochastic model code), read 2026-09-25

parameters.name: Plasma-membrane leak in
parameters.description: Constant Ca2+ entry.
parameters.source_note: Cao et al. 2014 Text S1 (6-state stochastic model code), read 2026-09-25

parameters.name: Receptor-operated entry per uM IP3
parameters.description: Jrocc = v_rocc x p (uM/s with p in uM).
parameters.source_note: Cao et al. 2014 Text S1 (6-state stochastic model code), read 2026-09-25

parameters.name: Store-operated entry maximum
parameters.description: Jsocc = V K^4 / (cs^4 + K^4): entry rises as the store empties.
parameters.source_note: Cao et al. 2014 Text S1 (6-state stochastic model code), read 2026-09-25

parameters.name: Store-operated entry half-point
parameters.description: SOCC K, in store Ca2+.
parameters.source_note: Cao et al. 2014 Text S1 (6-state stochastic model code), read 2026-09-25

parameters.name: Mouth Ca2+ per store Ca2+
parameters.description: An open receptor sees mouth_per_store x cs at its own mouth (cm = 120 (cs/100) in the code).
parameters.source_note: Cao et al. 2014 Text S1 (6-state stochastic model code), read 2026-09-25. At the model's resting store (about 490 uM) this is about 590 uM. pd.ca_mouth = 120 uM is the same rule at a store of 100 uM

parameters.name: Starting total Ca2+
parameters.description: The code's initial total (cytosolic units). With c = cb = puff.ca_rest it fixes the starting store, gamma2 (ct0 - c0/gamma1 - c0) = 449 uM, which the clamped store keeps.
parameters.source_note: Cao et al. 2014 Text S1 (6-state stochastic model code), read 2026-09-25: ct0 = 45, 'total calcium concentration'. It is not the model's steady state (that store is 630-1340 uM at 0.05-0.5 uM IP3, reached over minutes)

parameters.name: Fluo-4 total
parameters.description: Total indicator in the microdomain (Cao 2013 Eq. 12's B_fluo4). Set to 0 for the dye-free control.
parameters.source_note: Shuai, Rose & Parker 2006, Table 1 (fluo-4 dextran); the oocyte loading of Rose et al.

parameters.name: Fluo-4 on-rate
parameters.description: Ca2+ binding to fluo-4.
parameters.source_note: Shuai, Rose & Parker 2006, Table 1 (fluo-4 dextran)

parameters.name: Fluo-4 off-rate
parameters.description: Ca2+ unbinding; K_d = koff/kon = 2 uM.
parameters.source_note: Shuai, Rose & Parker 2006, Table 1 (fluo-4 dextran); Cao 2013's text: 'the dissociation constant of fluo-4 of 2 uM'

parameters.name: Puff threshold in mean blips
parameters.description: A fluorescence event is a puff when its peak dF/F0 exceeds this multiple of the mean blip (one-channel event) amplitude.
parameters.source_note: Cao 2013 set dF/F0 > 3 with a mean blip of 1.6; their absolute 3 depends on their Table S2, so the ratio 3/1.6 is carried

parameters.name: Event detection level
parameters.description: A fluorescence event is a run of bins whose dF/F0 exceeds this fraction of the steady dF/F0 one open receptor gives (the blip). Its peak open count says blip (one) or more.
parameters.source_note: Half a blip: a park-mode flicker (0.3 ms) stays below it, and a drive-mode opening (tens of ms) crosses it

parameters.name: Simulated time per IPI record
parameters.description: Length of each run behind an inter-puff-interval distribution.
parameters.source_note: Cao 2013's inter-puff intervals are 2-10 s, so 300 s gives 30-150 intervals per run

parameters.name: Simulated time per GUI microdomain run
parameters.description: Default length of the Puffs panel's microdomain run (the panel's Duration spin box starts here).
parameters.source_note: At 1x release and 0.1 uM IP3 about 20 puffs in 60 s, enough to fit Eq. 14; a run takes about 18 s on a worker (2026-09-25)

parameters.name: Slowest h42 recovery in the scan
parameters.description: The a_h42 scan (pd.lam_h42_closed) runs geometrically from this to domain.ah42_max.
parameters.source_note: Cao 2013 Fig. 4's range

parameters.name: Fastest h42 recovery in the scan
parameters.description: Top of the a_h42 scan.
parameters.source_note: Cao 2013 Fig. 4's range

parameters.name: Smallest cluster in the N scan
parameters.description: The amplitude-vs-N scan runs from this to domain.n_max.
parameters.source_note: Cao 2013 Figs. 6 and 8 (3-25 receptors)

parameters.name: Largest cluster in the N scan
parameters.description: Top of the amplitude-vs-N scan.
parameters.source_note: Cao 2013 Figs. 6 and 8

parameters.name: Largest release-rate multiple
parameters.description: The store scan multiplies domain.k_ipr by 1 up to this, which raises the coupling per open receptor from ~0.1 uM toward the ~0.5-2 uM where the mean-field cluster stays open.
parameters.source_note: Reaches the mean-field couplings of the Round 4 question

parameters.name: Points in the a_h42 scan
parameters.description: Geometric steps from domain.ah42_min to domain.ah42_max.
parameters.source_note: About two per factor of five over Cao 2013's range

parameters.name: Points in the N scan
parameters.description: Geometric steps (rounded, distinct) from domain.n_min to domain.n_max.
parameters.source_note: Enough to see a bend near Cao's N = 12

parameters.name: Points in the store scan
parameters.description: Geometric steps of the release-rate multiple from 1 to domain.store_scale_max.
parameters.source_note: About two per factor of five

parameters.name: Simulated time per store-scan run
parameters.description: Length of each clamped / free / mean-field run in the store scan.
parameters.source_note: Long enough for the store to fall by half at the sustained open fraction of the Round 4 question

parameters.name: Seed of every scan run
parameters.description: One seed for every point, so points differ only in the scanned constant.
parameters.source_note: Reproducibility

parameters.name: Release multiple matching Cao's mean blip
parameters.description: The k_ipr multiple the N scan reads at by default: there the measured mean blip (one-channel event) is dF/F0 1.33-1.66, against Cao 2013's 1.6. At 1x (Cao 2014's release) it is 0.58-0.72.
parameters.source_note: Found by N scans at 1, 2.5 and 4x on 2026-09-25 (Round 7.2); Cao 2013's own release is in its Table S2, which was not reachable
